key_insight: UA-ChatDev adds uncertainty estimation to multi-agent software development so low-confidence steps can be verified before errors propagate downstream.
engineering_relevance: This is relevant for building more reliable LLM-based coding assistants, especially in workflows where early mistakes can cascade into faulty requirements, code, or tests.
method: Estimate uncertainty from token-level log probabilities during agent responses.
Use phase-aware thresholds to decide when retrieval-based verification should be triggered.
Preserve role-based multi-agent collaboration while filtering unreliable intermediate outputs.
evidence_signal: On the SRDD benchmark, the method is reported to outperform existing single-agent and multi-agent baselines on completeness, executability, consistency, and overall quality, with ablations supporting the benefit of uncertainty-aware interaction.
watch_item: Token-level uncertainty thresholds may need careful calibration across development phases and tasks to avoid unnecessary verification or missed hallucinations.
paper_title: UA-ChatDev: Uncertainty-Aware Multi-Agent Collaboration for Reliable Software Development
